sources_add.egyptianstreets2025: Nawar, B. (26 March 2025). Unraveling the Pyramid Mystery: Claims of an Underground City Debunked. Egyptian Streets. "eight vertical structures extending over 2,100 feet beneath the pyramids"; "additional unidentified structures potentially lying at depths of 4,000 feet".
sources_add.euronews2025: Economou, A. (26 March 2025). Going underground: Experts clash over 'hidden city' beneath Egypt pyramids. Euronews. "massive vertical shafts, spiral staircases ... more than 2,000 feet (610m) beneath the surface".

notes_add: Extends giza: its terrain, pyramids and surveyed chambers, with the floor at 1,500 m below sea level so the published-style pictures show their whole depth axis.
The claimed structures are placed as in the Khafre claim's composition, their depths measured from Khafre's base (72 m).
